title: Autopay Discount Granted According to the Servicing Record — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Decision Table
content:
**Rule.** How the autopay discount granted on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans enrolment is worked out from the offered discount follows the late charges and collateral protection premiums among the loan's fee entries within the servicing-record look-back: when there are two or more late charges and at least one collateral protection premium, the offered discount is reduced by 0.05 point for every late charge and every collateral protection premium in the look-back, never below zero; when there are two or more late charges and no collateral protection premium, or at most one late charge and at least one collateral protection premium, one half of the offered discount is granted; when there is exactly one late charge and no collateral protection premium, the offered discount is reduced by a flat 0.05 point, never below zero; and when there is neither, the whole offered discount is granted.

## Entries counted

Late-charge fee entries and collateral-protection fee entries on the equipment loan, dated within the servicing-record look-back.

## Decision table

| Late charges in the look-back | Collateral protection premiums in the look-back | Discount granted |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | the whole offered discount |
| exactly one | none | the offered discount less a flat 0.05 point, never below zero |
| two or more | none | one half (0.5) of the offered discount |
| none | one or more | one half (0.5) of the offered discount |
| exactly one | one or more | one half (0.5) of the offered discount |
| two or more | one or more | the offered discount less 0.05 point for every late charge and every premium, never below zero |

## Hypothetical figures (offered discount 0.25)

| Late charges | Premiums | Granted |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0.25 |
| 1 | 0 | 0.20 |
| 2 | 0 | 0.125 |
| 1 | 1 | 0.125 |
| 2 | 1 | 0.25 less 0.15, that is 0.10 |
| 4 | 2 | 0.25 less 0.30, held at 0 |
